content.comment_body: Hello, I've designed a web page using [product_name] [product_name]. My goal is to make it accessible from a mobile device. Currently, my controller ([product_name]) is connected to my PC via ethernet cable, and I assume some connection to my mobile phone is necessary. If I enter my controller's IP address into my phone's browser (Samsung, Android, Chrome or Firefox), I receive a connection timeout. However, doing the same from my PC works without issues. Is there a way to resolve this? Can my web page be opened on a mobile device? Also, the manual I referenced (see attachment), specifically on page p9/74, doesn't mention Android as a supported operating system.
Hello [user_name], Are both devices on the same subnet?

If your [product_name] is only connected to your PC with an ethernet cable, then only your PC's web browser will be able to connect to the [product_name] web server. To enable access from other devices, add the [product_name] to your WiFi network. This way, any device on the same WiFi can open the web page. Hope this clarifies things.

Thanks for your reply. Could you provide more details about adding the [product_name] to a WiFi network? I tried setting my [product_name]'s IP address to my PC's IPv4 address I found using command prompt, but received an error message in [product_name] when downloading the code.
I think they should be on the same subnet. If that's the case, are there any other troubleshooting steps I can try?

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that accessing a web page hosted by [product_name] works from a PC, but not from a mobile device due to connection timeouts. The main issue seems related to devices being on separate networks and lack of clear instructions for mobile access. Problems occur when setting IP addresses in the [product_name] environment, and there is some confusion about compatibility with Android devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward access to their [product_name] device's web interface from a mobile browser, regardless of operating system, and also seek clear advice on configuring network settings to allow web access.
